10160401.text: (Only Noctilucous Jade of radiant grade at the very least is acceptable for use in the Rite of Parting.)

10160402.text: (Who'd have thought the hilichurls' cooking pot in Dadaupa Gorge would be a reliable means of assessing the quality...)

10160411.text: (The seven kites used in the ceremony, which represent The Seven.)

10160412.text: #(How long before I find the one who took my {F#brother}{M#sister}?)

10160421.text: (Everlasting Incense... The lengths we went to to get our hands on that.)

10160422.text: (I guess they'll burn it during the Rite of Parting...?)

10160423.text: (It should be a spectacular sight... two million, nine-hundred-and-ninety thousand Mora's worth of incense, going up in smoke.)

10160431.text: (A specially prepared perfume, made from a rare type of Silk Flower. It has a faint scent.)

10160432.text: (Still, why would Rex Lapis go for the scent preferred by older women...)

10160441.text: (A vital implement used in the Rite of Parting. The cleansing sound of the bell rids the deity of all impurities from the mortal world as it bids them farewell... Or something like that?)

10160442.text: (It's hard to believe someone would store such a precious object in a teapot filled with cobwebs.)
